scope_note: Evidence-supported guidance is separated from conservative inference and explicit product requirements.

principles.principle: Select experiences for the target work instead of reproducing every true fact.
principles.observable_check: Content selection points to job requirements and bounded relevant evidence.

principles.principle: Use action, concrete task and supported result or purpose; an accomplishment need not contain a number.
principles.observable_check: Bullet identifies actual contribution; invented outcome or metric fails.

principles.principle: Choose verbs that preserve the candidate’s actual role and ownership.
principles.observable_check: Studied, used, consumed, implemented, operated and led remain distinguishable.

principles.principle: Use present tense for ongoing work and past tense for completed contributions.
principles.observable_check: Tense is compatible with event timing.
exceptions_or_limits: A completed accomplishment in a current job can use past tense.

principles.principle: Resume length depends on experience, purpose and explicit application instructions.
principles.conservative_default: Concise one page for many early-career cases; allow two pages when relevant experience warrants it.
principles.observable_check: Length preference and destination constraints preserved.
exceptions_or_limits: Academic CVs differ; current US federal instructions cap resumes at two pages.

principles.principle: Use a summary only if it adds specific supported positioning beyond nearby sections.
principles.observable_check: Summary adds relevant information without unsupported seniority or experience totals.

principles.principle: Preserve exact employment, education, credentials and chronology; tailoring changes emphasis rather than history.
principles.observable_check: Structured facts and evidence match every emitted identity/date/credential.

principles.principle: Avoid first-person pronouns and generic responsibilities when specific contributions are available.
principles.observable_check: Soft writing review; natural valid variation is allowed.

principles.principle: Check the whole document for repeated achievements and consistent terminology.
principles.observable_check: Same-event repetition is justified or removed across sections.

principles.principle: Keep sensitive personal attributes off a typical US industry resume unless the user specifically requires appropriate inclusion.
principles.observable_check: No inferred age, health, religion, family status or demographic facts.
exceptions_or_limits: Geographic conventions and legitimate application instructions differ; route uncertain cases to user review.

principles.principle: Education and project prominence should reflect the candidate’s relevant background and target position.
principles.observable_check: Students can foreground relevant projects; experienced applicants prioritize relevant work, without one compulsory order.
